states.n: DR Congo: all of Lake Albert’s western half and the land between it and the author’s line along its shore
Greece: Kastellorizo (Megisti), Ro, Strongyli and Psomi (not drawn by the base map; traced)
Spain (with the Balearics, Canaries, Ceuta and Melilla)
France: French Cerdagne (the communes south of the Pyrenees crest, in the upper Segre valley; part of the Iberian Peninsula)
Nigeria: north-east Borno and Yobe, 23 local government areas (Lake Chad, Sahel)
Cameroon: the far north, 6 departments (Lake Chad, Sahel)
France: the strips of the Iberian Peninsula along the Pyrenees (OpenStreetMap outline)
Italy: Sicily with its islands (Aegadian, Aeolian, Ustica, Pantelleria, Pelagie)
France: Corsica (Corsica and Sardinia, the Sardo-Corsican islands)
Italy: Sardinia with its islands (Corsica and Sardinia, the Sardo-Corsican islands)
Russia: Derbent (Bāb al-Abwāb) and southern Dagestan (the Samur valley and Derbent’s hinterland)
India (with the Andaman, Nicobar and Lakshadweep islands)
British Indian Ocean Territory (Chagos; UK, claimed by Mauritius)
China: the parts of Jammu and Kashmir it administers (Aksai Chin and the Shaksgam valley)

Russia: the North Caucasus, the Volga and southern Urals to Tatarstan and Bashkortostan, districts of southern Kirov and western Kurgan, and the centre and west to Pskov, Tver, Yaroslavl, Ivanovo, Moscow, Vladimir and Nizhny Novgorod (whole regions and districts to the author’s lines)
Ukraine (the base map draws Crimea and Sevastopol, disputed, under Russia)
